summary: Sniper feature backend contract is fully correct (9/9 unit + 4/4 HTTP integration tests pass). Frontend lobby weapon-picker UI is fully correct (selection, persistence-across-refresh, positioning above QUICK MATCH all verified). However there is a CRITICAL integration bug that makes the sniper equip look like ak47 in-game: the client's input-tick payload hardcodes weapon='ak47', and the server (input handler) trusts that field and overwrites player.weapon every tick, clobbering the sniper seed. Net result: user selects sniper in lobby, enters a match, HUD shows AK-47 25/25 and all shots use AK config on the server. This must be fixed before the sniper feature can be released.

integration_issues.flow: Lobby selects sniper -> enter match -> in-game weapon still ak47
integration_issues.issue: Game.jsx line 464 hardcodes `curWeapon = engineRef.current?.currentWeapon === 'tertiary' ? 'laser' : 'ak47'` in the input-tick send. Server input handler at server.py:4130-4133 accepts `msg['weapon']` and overwrites `player.weapon` unconditionally when the value is in WEAPON_CONFIGS. So on every input tick the client resets the server-side sniper seed back to ak47. Cascade: server state broadcast then sends p.weapon='ak47' -> engine state-in handler (engine.js:3748) never sets primaryWeaponId='sniper' -> HUD stays on AK-47 25/25 -> subsequent shoot payloads (which use primaryWeaponId) also send weapon='ak47'. Observed live: after selecting SNIPER in lobby and entering PRACTICE -> Offline mode, `window.__virtueEngine.primaryWeaponId === 'ak47'`, HUD ammo shows 25/25 with 'AK-47' label, ammo dict is `{ak47:25, sniper:1, laser:60}` (so client knows about sniper, it's just never selected).

action_items: Optional hardening (server): consider not accepting `msg['weapon']` on 'input' ticks for the primary-slot switch — the primary weapon is loadout-scoped, not a live switchable, so the input tick only needs to signal 'laser' vs 'primary'. That would prevent similar client-side regressions in the future.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:4130-4133 blindly trusts client-sent `weapon` on every input tick and overwrites the authoritative loadout — this is the amplification vector for the Game.jsx bug and is a general anti-pattern; consider restricting to laser/primary category instead of full weapon-id.

Game.jsx:464 and Game.jsx:488 duplicate the 'tertiary -> laser else primaryWeaponId' logic; extract a helper to avoid the two branches drifting again (that drift is exactly what caused this bug — the shoot payload was updated but the input tick was not).

engine.js:3748 gates primaryWeaponId update on p.weapon being ak47/sniper, which is fine — but there is no client-side cache of the lobby-selected weapon before the first state broadcast arrives. Consider seeding engine.primaryWeaponId from /profile/me on Game mount so the HUD isn't briefly wrong even after the server bug is fixed.

success_rate.frontend: 50% — lobby picker perfect, in-game equip broken

seed_data_creation: None. Test flips player1's primary_weapon between sniper/ak47; final test leaves it as ak47.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After E1 fixes Game.jsx:464 to use primaryWeaponId, re-run the in-game verification: (1) login as player1, select sniper in lobby, (2) PRACTICE -> Offline mode, (3) wait for match start (~15-25s of intermission), (4) evaluate `window.__virtueEngine.primaryWeaponId` — must be 'sniper', (5) HUD label must read 'SNIPER' and ammo '1/1', (6) verify hipfire block by setting `window.__virtueEngine.ads=false` and calling `window.__virtueEngine._tryShoot()` — ammo must stay at 1, no shoot event, (7) verify ADS fire by setting ads=true and calling _tryShoot — ammo drops to 0 and 2s reload begins, (8) 1-shot-kill verification: aim at a bot and fire — killfeed entry must appear. Backend contract (test_sniper_weapon.py + test_weapon_endpoint_integration.py) is already 100% and stable — no need to re-run unless server.py changes.
rca of the issue: Two coupled code paths must agree on the current primary weapon: (A) the client's shoot payload's `weapon` field (correctly wired to engine.primaryWeaponId in Game.jsx:488), and (B) the client's input tick's `weapon` field (Game.jsx:464 — this is the missed spot, still hardcoded to 'ak47'). The server input handler (server.py:4130-4133) mirrors msg.weapon into player.weapon on every input tick, so path (B) wins the race against the WS-connect seed. Because the state broadcast then echoes player.weapon='ak47' back, engine.primaryWeaponId also stays 'ak47' (engine.js:3748-3750 only updates on server-authoritative broadcast). Fix: change Game.jsx:463-464 to use engine.primaryWeaponId, identical to line 488. Reproduction (verified): (1) POST /api/profile/me/weapon {weapon:'sniper'} -> 200; (2) GET /api/profile/me -> primary_weapon:'sniper' (confirmed); (3) enter offline match; (4) `window.__virtueEngine.primaryWeaponId` -> 'ak47' (WRONG); (5) HUD shows AK-47 25/25 (WRONG). Mitigation: apply the one-line fix above; consider server-side tightening to not accept weapon changes via 'input' ticks.
